The workbook generation failed because expected data blocks in the 'Task' sheet were missing or empty, resulting in 'None' values during verification.
The test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats failed with multiple AssertionErrors. Specifically, cells in ranges H12:L17 (top block) and H35:L40 (net metric) returned None instead of the expected float values (e.g., H12 expected 612.5, got None). The verifier used openpyxl via a subprocess call to pytest on /tests/test_outputs.py, confirming that while the file was created, the required calculation matrices were not populated.
